title: Galaxy AI
summary:
Galaxy AI is a collection of artificial intelligence features developed by Samsung Electronics for use in Galaxy-branded mobile devices. First released with the Samsung Galaxy S24 series in January 2024, the system integrates both on-device and cloud-based processing to support features such as language translation, image editing, and content search.

Galaxy AI integrates Samsung's own AI models with external technologies, including Google's Gemini AI, to provide a variety of context-sensitive functions. While Galaxy AI itself is not a Large Language Model, it uses LLMs for some of its features. Samsung partnered with Google Cloud to leverage its Gemini LLMs (including Gemini Nano, Gemini Pro and Gemini Ultra) to run specific functions on Galaxy devices. In mainland China, the cloud partner is Baidu providing its Ernie model, while in international markets the cloud partner is Google providing its Gemini Pro model.

Galaxy AI includes multiple tools that apply artificial intelligence to specific user tasks, such as communication, notetaking, photography, and productivity. Key features include Call Assist and Live Translate for two-way voice and text translation during calls; Interpreter for real-time spoken and on-screen translations for face-to-face conversations supporting over a dozen languages; Now Brief, a daily summary interface presenting scrollable cards with updates such as weather, calendar events, and smart home status; Now Nudge for context-aware suggestions to streamline tasks; and AI-powered photo editing features for stylized image generation.

Samsung emphasizes privacy protection and ethical AI development as key priorities. On-device processing is used for sensitive AI functions, minimizing data transmission to external servers, while encrypted cloud-based AI is employed selectively for high-processing tasks. One UI 6.1 was released on 17 January 2024 with the Galaxy S24 series, and later versions of One UI mainly include new AI-based features marketed as Galaxy AI.
